findings.title: useAiJobApplicationSummary still fires for non-succeeded statuses when summary exists
findings.spec_requirement: Spec 'AI summary data fetching': 'fetch the full data only when status is succeeded and the rich layout needs rendering'
findings.evidence: PlatoTab.tsx lines 38-41: useAiJobApplicationSummary is called with aiSummary?.id whenever a summary exists. When status is pending/in_progress/extracted/textract_processing/failed, the query fires with a valid ID, making an unnecessary API call. The QA Run 1 fix added an enabled guard for id=0 but did not restrict to succeeded-only.
findings.recommendation: Change the hook call to pass aiJobApplicationSummaryId: (status === 'succeeded' && aiSummary?.id) || 0. The enabled guard in the hook will prevent the fetch when id is 0.
findings.note: Agent 1 observed this but did not elevate to a finding because data is consumed only when succeeded. However, the spec explicitly requires fetching only when succeeded, making this a spec-implementation mismatch (always HIGH in Layer 1).

dismissed.title: Kebab button renders without functionality in zero states
